# Game Idea: Asteroid Escape

- **Genre:** Endless runner / arcade
- **Core mechanic:** Player pilots a ship using arrow keys (or mouse) to dodge procedurally generated asteroids on an HTML canvas.
- **Goal:** Survive as long as possible while collecting energy orbs to keep the ship powered.
- **Lose condition:** Collision with an asteroid OR running out of energy.
- **Visuals:** Simple geometric shapes (triangles for ship, circles for asteroids) with a parallax star background.
- **Scoring:** Time survived + collected orbs.

1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML
3: (() => {
4:   // Create a starfield background
5:   const starCount = 100;
6:   const stars = [];
7:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
8:     stars.push({
9:       x: Math.random() * width,
10:       y: Math.random() * height,
11:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
12:       speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2
13:     });
14:   }
15:   function updateStars() {
16:     for (const s of stars) {
17:       s.y += s.speed;
18:       if (s.y > height) {
19:         s.y = 0;
20:         s.x = Math.random() * width;
21:       }
22:     }
23:   }
24:   function drawStars() {
25:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111'; // dark background
26:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
27:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
28:     for (const s of stars) {
29:       ctx.beginPath();
30:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
31:       ctx.fill();
32:     }
33:   }
34: 
35:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
36:   // Audio setup
37:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
38:   function playBeep(freq, dur) {
39:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
40:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
41:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
42:     osc.type = 'sine';
43:     osc.connect(gain);
44:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
45:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, audioCtx.currentTime);
46:     osc.start();
47:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
48:   }
49:   function playThrust() { playBeep(400, 0.05); }
50:   function playCollision() { playBeep(100, 0.3); }
51: 
52:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
53:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
54:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
55:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
56: 
57:   // Ship definition (triangle)
58:   const ship = {
59:     x: width / 2,
60:     y: height * 0.85,
61:     size: 20,
62:     speed: 4,
63:     dx: 0,
64:     dy: 0,
65:     draw() {
66:       // Ship with gradient and stroke
67:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y - this.size, this.x, this.y + this.size);
68:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
69:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#050');
70:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
71:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#0a0';
72:       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
73:       ctx.beginPath();
74:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y - this.size);
75:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.size, this.y + this.size);
76:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.size, this.y + this.size);
77:       ctx.closePath();
78:       ctx.fill();
79:       ctx.stroke();
80:     },
81:     update() {
82:       this.x += this.dx;
83:       this.y += this.dy;
84:       // keep inside canvas
85:       this.x = Math.max(this.size, Math.min(width - this.size, this.x));
86:     }
87:   };
88: 
89:   // Input handling
90:   const keys = {};
91:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
92:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
93:   function handleInput() {
94:     ship.dx = 0;
95:     ship.dy = 0;
96:     let moving = false;
97:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) { ship.dx = -ship.speed; moving = true; }
98:     if (keys.ArrowRight) { ship.dx = ship.speed; moving = true; }
99:     if (keys.ArrowUp) { ship.dy = -ship.speed; moving = true; }
100:     if (keys.ArrowDown) { ship.dy = ship.speed; moving = true; }
101:     if (moving) playThrust();
102:   }
103: 
104:   // Asteroid class
105:   class Asteroid {
106:     constructor() {
107:       this.r = Math.random() * 15 + 10;
108:       this.x = Math.random() * (width - 2 * this.r) + this.r;
109:       this.y = -this.r;
110:       this.speed = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
111:     }
112:     update() { this.y += this.speed; }
113: draw() {
114:         // Asteroid with radial gradient
115:         const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(this.x, this.y, this.r * 0.2, this.x, this.y, this.r);
116:         grad.addColorStop(0, '#ddd');
117:         grad.addColorStop(1, '#777');
118:         ctx.fillStyle = grad;
119:         ctx.strokeStyle = '#555';
120:         ctx.lineWidth = 1;
121:         ctx.beginPath();
122:         ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
123:         ctx.fill();
124:         ctx.stroke();
125:       }
126:     offScreen() { return this.y - this.r > height; }
127:   }
128: 
129:   const asteroids = [];
130:   let lastSpawn = 0;
131:   const spawnInterval = 1000; // ms
132: 
133:   // Scoring
134:   let startTime = performance.now();
135:   let score = 0;
136: 
137:   function spawnAsteroid(now) {
138:     if (now - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
139:       asteroids.push(new Asteroid());
140:       lastSpawn = now;
141:     }
142:   }
143: 
144:   function checkCollision(a) {
145:     const dx = a.x - ship.x;
146:     const dy = a.y - ship.y;
147:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
148:     // Approximate ship as circle with radius ship.size
149:     return dist < a.r + ship.size;
150:   }
151: 
152:   function update(now) {
153:     // Update and render background stars
154:     updateStars();
155:     drawStars();
156:     handleInput();
157:     ship.update();
158:     ship.draw();
159: 
160:     spawnAsteroid(now);
161:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
162:       const a = asteroids[i];
163:       a.update();
164:       a.draw();
165:       if (checkCollision(a)) {
166:         // Game over with sound
167:         playCollision();
168:         alert('Game Over! Score: ' + Math.floor(score));
169:         // Reset
170:         asteroids.length = 0;
171:         startTime = performance.now();
172:         score = 0;
173:         return; // stop this frame
174:       }
175:       if (a.offScreen()) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
176:     }
177:     // Update score based on time survived
178:     score = (now - startTime) / 1000;
179:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
180:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
181:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
182:     requestAnimationFrame(update);
183:   }
184: 
185:   requestAnimationFrame(update);
186: })();
